title: Vaccines
summary: Misinformation about vaccine safety, efficacy, and side effects persists despite extensive scientific evidence supporting vaccination.
introduction: Vaccine misinformation has proliferated across communities worldwide, leading to decreased vaccination rates and resurgence of preventable diseases. Common myths include false claims about vaccines causing autism, containing harmful ingredients, overwhelming immune systems, or being unnecessary due to improved hygiene. These misconceptions often stem from discredited studies, misunderstanding of vaccine ingredients, and distrust of pharmaceutical companies or health authorities. Scientific consensus, supported by decades of research across multiple countries, consistently demonstrates that vaccines are safe, effective, and crucial for individual and community health.
